title: EMONET-FACE: An Expert-Annotated Benchmark for Synthetic Emotion Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Controlling and evaluating demographic representation by balancing gender identity (man, woman, non-binary) in the text-to-image generation prompts for the dataset.
Controlling and evaluating demographic representation by ensuring 14 different ethnic backgrounds are represented in the dataset generation prompts to mitigate Western-centric representation bias.
Controlling and evaluating demographic representation by capturing a wide age range (20–80 years, in 10-year increments) in the dataset generation prompts.
